setup: Use Linux with CPUs 0..4 available, Python 3.12, g++ with C++17. Sources currently contain absolute workspace paths; extract under the stated directory or update those paths explicitly.

Install requirements.txt; install python-flint also into math_vendor if needed by the explicit import paths. Native helpers compile from the supplied C++ source. Cargo/rustc were absent in the measured environment.

For independent trace source review, restore the original supplied PDF at its recorded attachment path or update trace_audit/review.py to its location; the original PDF is not redistributed in this bundle.
result_preservation: Rerunning benchmark commands replaces generated result files. Preserve the supplied archive before rerunning. The timing snapshot preserves the original incidence implementation; current candidate.py fixes continuation past uninformative witnesses and its audit proves all original fixtures unchanged.
cost_boundary: Algorithm tables rebuild problem-specific state and charge public mixed-label generation separately per attempt. Interpreter/import/native-build startup is excluded from persistent-call timings and retained separately where measured. Do not treat these tables as literal fresh-process latency.
test_data: *.validation.json files contain toy secrets and exact truth for audit only. Attack algorithms consume only public *.json fixture files specified in the manifest. Planted controls use test-only secret relabelling and are excluded from natural timing statistics.
scope: Machine-word prime fields, growing B through 128 for incidence and divisor degree through 256 for trace. No direct 256-bit or binary-field implementation and no cryptographic-size ECDLP benchmark.
prior_art: repo_controls/repository_assessment.json and source_provenance.json distinguish portable ports from exact upstream execution; original Rust binary was not replayed.
